title: ci(deploy): deploy the US and EU instances in parallel

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review 9792da2c-b38d-4103-a063-b80a573f92ef 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Two-line workflow change; parallel instances share no state — distinct stage, DB and account-wide resources owned by us only. Loss of the US canary is intentional and stated.
<sub>no findings · tests not needed · risk medium</sub>

`deploy-prd-eu` now waits only on `ingest-binary`, so both production instances deploy at the same time. The instances share no mutable resource, so the change is safe to merge; it trades the US-as-canary sequencing for half the deploy time.

- `deploy-prd-eu` needs only `ingest-binary`, dropping its dependency on `deploy-prd`

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- Instances are isolated: `MAPLE_STAGE` prd/prd-eu (`deploy-prd-instance.yml:28`) and `resolvePlanetscaleDatabase` returns maple vs maple-eu (`stage.ts:232`)
- No shared deploy resource: `profile.deploys.sharedApps` is false for prd-eu (`profile.test.ts:22`), and account-wide Workers Observability destinations are owned only by us (`observability.ts:17`)
- `deployment-gate` still needs both jobs with `always()` (`deploy-prd.yml:53`), so a skipped or failed US deploy still fails the run

</details>

<sub>`62392d6` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.</sub>
